messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: high - service/runtime-gpu-pool-4 is in CrashLoop (segfault). 8 hosts flapping, severity: P1. @oncall pls ack :rotating_light:
alex: acked. jumping in. seeing a spike of OOM+SIGSEGV on vllm-runtime pods in gpu-pool-4.
maria: i'm seeing identical coredumps on two different node types (a100-40g, a100-80g). stacktrace points into libruntime_fused.so.
jia: grabbing logs now. docker logs show repeated `RuntimeError: CUDA driver lost` immediately before segfault.
sam: paste of recent container stdout: ```
[2026-03-15T02:12:40Z] NVML: GPU 0: out-of-memory while allocating 2048MB
[2026-03-15T02:12:40Z] cudaMemcpyAsync failed: unspecified launch failure
[2026-03-15T02:12:40Z] Aborted (core dumped)
```
kai: also seeing kernel oops messages on node-17: `nvml: GPU reset`, `NVRM: GPU at PCI:0000:65:00: GPU has fallen off the bus`.
maria: hypothesis: a TensorRT fused-kernel optimization triggers illegal memory access under certain sequence lengths, causing driver reset -> container segfaults. reproducer might need long context and batch mix.
alex: mitigation plan: 1) cordon + drain the most affected nodes in gpu-pool-4, 2) scale up fallback pool without fused kernels, 3) roll workload to runtime-image:prod-2026-03-08 (previous stable), 4) collect core+dmesg and uplink to nightly for root cause.
oncall: i'm standing by to handoff/coordinate. taking pager for next 30m.
support-bot: customer-impact: 12% of requests to hosted instances in us-west-2 returned 5xx in last 10m. 3 customers reported timeouts to support. tagging CS for follow-up.
alex: executing cordon on node-17 and node-23 now. ```kubectl cordon node-17 && kubectl drain node-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force```
jia: pods are evicting; some stuck due to local tmp files. forcing restart of runtime daemonset on fallback pool.
sam: rollback command queued: `kubectl set image ds/vllm-runtime runtime=redwood/runtime:prod-2026-03-08 --namespace=redwood-runtime`
maria: while rollback proceeds, add env var to disable fused kernels in new nodes: `RUNTIME_FUSED_ATTENTION=false`. this should avoid TRT fused paths.
kai: collecting core and gdb backtrace: ```
#0 0x00007f1a2b4f3a1c in fused_attn_kernel() from /opt/runtime/lib/libruntime_fused.so
#1 0x00007f1a2b5012b0 in run_inference from /opt/runtime/lib/libruntime.so
#2 0x000055b2f3a12cde in main
```
alex: good. upload cores to s3://redwood-incidents/4512345678/ and open internal issue with attached dumps.
oncall: updating incident header: short impact summary to exec: high-latency and 5xx for some hosted customers, currently mitigated by rollback and cordon.
support-bot: CS escalation: notify top-5 paying customers in us-west-2, message template prepared. need decision to send.
alex: hold on mass customer comms until we see rollback health. if rates drop under 1% fail we can send proactive note.
jia: rollback completed on 7/8 nodes; error rate dropped from 12% -> 2% in last 5m. a few pods still crash on older nodes (maybe hardware fault).
maria: still seeing NVML resets on node-23 even after rollback. recommend replacing node-23 (possible ECC/hardware issue).
kai: opened a ticket with infra to reprovision node-23 and run `nvidia-smi -q` diagnostic.
oncall: handing off to next oncall in 45m. current mitigation: rollback to prod-2026-03-08, cordon node-17/node-23, scale fallback pool with RUNTIME_FUSED_ATTENTION=false.
alex: what are follow-ups? 1) reproduce with long-seq workload and TRT fused kernel enabled, 2) add guard in runtime to detect illegal mem access and gracefully fallback, 3) more robust telemetry around seq-length/batch mixes that hit fused path.
support-bot: action item for CS: follow-up messages to impacted customers queued, include ETA: 2-4 hours for node reprovision and full recovery.
maria: opening a changelist to revert the fused-kernel roll and include additional safety checks. PR link: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/changes/8934
alex: thanks all. will keep thread open for final validation and RCA. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation in place, monitoring for 1 hour. severity downgraded to P2 if stable.
